download_fasttext_vectors: download the FastText Common Crawl 300d 2M word vectors to a specified datapath
create_vocab_vectors: create a torchtext vocab Vectors object for crawl-300d-2M.vec from the FastText URL
cache_fasttext_model: cache the FastText crawl-300d-2M.vec model in the datapath models directory
review_download_function: review the download function that returns a torchtext Vectors object for FastText embeddings
summarize_vectors_module: summarize the FastText Common Crawl vectors module for use with Parlai models
